scope: Reachable named XSD elements/attributes for eight dataset roots; repeated occurrence audit. Simple-content text, wildcard payloads, identity constraints, enumeration/value semantics and conditional requiredness need separate conformance evidence. Not a complete semantic equivalence claim.

mappingRules.branches: JSON Schema properties/anyOf/oneOf/allOf/items including tuple items; ->$ref marks traversal into a referenced schema. Category vocabulary dependency definitions and wildcard payloads are excluded.
mappingRules.requiredInParentBranches: Distinct observed direct requiredness across mapped object parents. False does not mean absent conditional requirements. Stricter TIDAS documentation remains deliberate.
mappingRules.unmapped: Explicitly mapped=false, not a confirmed defect: inspect namespace attributes, generic extension/type branches and deliberate TIDAS extensions separately.
mappingRules.limits: XSD element-local occurrence only; does not multiply ancestor group occurrence. JSON parent required lists are structural observations, not an evaluation of conditions. Two language sets are structurally equivalent under the package verifier.

checkedExclusions.undeclared-extension-properties: Global references common:other, optional LCIA locations/LCIAMethodologies and Process metaDataOnly are undeclared but accepted by open object schemas; lack of a named mapping is not rejection. No additionalProperties policy change is included.
checkedExclusions.elementary-classification-identity: Optional name/categories are accepted by the open categorization object. Its class tuple retains the existing pinned taxonomy design.
checkedExclusions.supply-location-language: TIDAS keeps vocabulary-code supply locations; XML language annotations on these codes have no schema mapping. Repeated vocabulary codes are supported, arbitrary multilingual location descriptions are not added.
checkedExclusions.conditional-and-value-semantics: Occurrence inventory is supplemented by conformance tests for repaired IDs, numeric/simple-content values, conditional Process reference and alias exclusivity; it is not a complete equality audit of all schema constraints.
